name: correction_with_conflict
goal: The manager asserts a delivery date in conversation; a brief runs; the office corrects the invoice to a different date; the next brief must open with what changed, cite N16, and surface the conflict with the manager's statement without overwriting it.

steps.ask: Alder told me INV-099 lands on Tuesday the 6th, record that.
steps.label: manager asserts a date

rubric.text: The second brief opens with what changed since the last brief: INV-099 is now scheduled for 2026-10-08 and the receipt alarm cleared.
The second brief cites note N16.

The second brief says the manager's earlier statement (2026-10-06) now disagrees with the corrected record (2026-10-08), that neither was overwritten, and which value planning uses until the manager confirms.
The second brief says the manager's policies and preferences are unchanged (retained).
